rules.title: Server secret reachable from client code
rules.description: A secret-shaped env key is either inlined into the client bundle via NEXT_PUBLIC_* or referenced inside a client component.

rules.title: Supabase table without row-level security
rules.description: A CREATE TABLE in a Supabase migration without ALTER TABLE ... ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, or a policy USING (true).

rules.title: Server-only module imported into client code
rules.description: A client component imports a server-only module (fs, next/headers, a server lib, a DB client): the import either breaks the build or leaks server code into the bundle.

rules.title: Route handler consumes unvalidated input
rules.description: A POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE route handler reads request.json()/formData() and uses it without a schema/validation call.

rules.title: Protected route without a session check
rules.description: A page or route handler under a protected prefix (app/dashboard, app/admin, app/account, app/(protected)) with no session/user check in its file or a sibling layout.

rules.title: Hard-coded local URL or unsafe http endpoint
rules.description: A committed source file hard-codes localhost/127.0.0.1 or an http:// URL that will break or leak in production.

rules.title: Env key used in code missing from .env.example
rules.description: process.env.KEY referenced in source with no matching key in .env.example/.env.sample — a fresh deploy fails or silently skips config.

rules.title: Critical flow with no test file
rules.description: Each route handler should have a test/spec file named after its directory (e.g. app/api/pay/route.ts ↔ pay.test.ts) somewhere in the repo.

findings.title: Server-only module imported into client code
findings.remediation: Remove the server import (fs) from the client file; call a route handler or pass the data in from a server component instead.

findings.title: Supabase table without row-level security
findings.remediation: Add ALTER TABLE orders ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; plus a policy scoped to the owning user, e.g. USING (auth.uid() = user_id).

findings.title: Supabase table without row-level security
findings.evidence: create policy "anyone" on payments for all using (true);
findings.remediation: USING (true) grants the action to every role including anon. Replace with a user-scoped predicate such as USING (auth.uid() = user_id).

findings.title: Server secret reachable from client code
findings.remediation: Rename the env key to drop the NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix (it is bundled to the browser): use a server-only name like SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY and read it in a route handler or server component.

findings.title: Server secret reachable from client code
findings.remediation: Move the SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY access into a route handler or server component; anything read in a client file is shipped to every browser.

findings.title: Hard-coded local URL or unsafe http endpoint
findings.remediation: Move "http://localhost:4000/send" into an env key (e.g. process.env.APP_BASE_URL) with .env.example documenting it; keep https for any remote endpoint.

findings.title: Hard-coded local URL or unsafe http endpoint
findings.remediation: Move "http://localhost:4000" into an env key (e.g. process.env.APP_BASE_URL) with .env.example documenting it; keep https for any remote endpoint.

findings.title: Protected route without a session check
findings.remediation: Check the session at the top of the handler/page or in the route-group layout: const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession(); if (!session) redirect('/login').

findings.title: Route handler consumes unvalidated input
findings.remediation: Validate the body before use: const parsed = schema.safeParse(await request.json()); if (!parsed.success) return Response.json({ error: 'invalid input' }, { status: 400 });

findings.title: Route handler consumes unvalidated input
findings.remediation: Validate the body before use: const parsed = schema.safeParse(await request.json()); if (!parsed.success) return Response.json({ error: 'invalid input' }, { status: 400 });

findings.title: Env key used in code missing from .env.example
findings.remediation: Add NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY= to .env.example so a fresh clone knows the key is required.

findings.title: Env key used in code missing from .env.example
findings.remediation: Add STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET= to .env.example so a fresh clone knows the key is required.

findings.title: Critical flow with no test file
findings.remediation: Add notify.test.ts exercising the handler's happy path and one rejection case (e.g. vitest: const res = await POST(new Request(...))).

findings.title: Critical flow with no test file
findings.remediation: Add pay.test.ts exercising the handler's happy path and one rejection case (e.g. vitest: const res = await POST(new Request(...))).
